description.zh: 高亮、R 拿取、头灯、基础负重、快存与格子锁、菜单暂停和同列车供料，均可单独开关；另有种植配方和物品生成的数量、机会倍率，默认不改变生成。
description.en: Highlights, R take all, headlamp, carry weight, quick stash and slot locks, menu pause and train supply with individual switches; optional farming and loot quantity/chance multipliers. Loot is unchanged by default.
